classes.purpose: Static buff (status-effect) definition record managed by a CInfoManager<CBuffInfo> singleton keyed by buffId. Holds a buff's category/type, exclusivity group, and references to its effect script/resource. Most functions in this bundle are combat/entity helpers that look up buff definitions by id and either apply them, validate cross-references, or serialize hit/damage events; the auto-labeler tagged every function 'CBuffInfo::GetManagers' because they all touch the CBuffInfo singleton-name string.

constants: MaxSpAttack=4 (special-attack element entries at index 0x1a,0x1c,0x1e,0x20, stride 2)
ExtraBuffArray=21 (second buff-id array at index 0x2f..0x43 in 1142dcd0)
SpAttackElemId range: 0 < id <= 0x10 (valid elemental attack id)
formulas: Manager lookup GetInfoById(id): idx = id - base[0x30]; require idx>=0 && idx<base[0x24] && base[0x28]!=0; record = base[0x20][idx / base[0x28]][idx % base[0x28]] (paged/hive array keyed by buffId)

HitDamage = ceil(physical=comp[0]) + ceil(comp[1]+comp[2]+comp[3]+comp[4]+comp[5]) where comp[] are the 6 damage floats at start of the hit descriptor (a small 0.0 constant DAT_11de9890 is added to the elemental sum)
spAttackFlag = OR over the 4 special-attack entries of (1 << spAttackElemId) when 0 < id <= 0x10
buffFlag = OR of per-buff bit (FUN_116a74a0/FUN_116a7480) over the up-to-10 valid buffs; 32-bit in 11011c80, 64-bit ("%I64u", two halves) in 1101b760
buffCategory bitmask: presence |= 1 << record[0x420]; and categoryMap[record[0x420]] = record (116e5260)

methods.purpose: Lazy-inits and returns the static CInfoManager<CBuffInfo> singleton (registers name 'CBuffInfo::GetManagers' via StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager>). Returns DAT_123be35c.

Given a hit descriptor, walks its 10 buff-id slots, validates each buffId against the manager, and emits script events 'AddBuff' (EventName/BuffId/BuffType) then 'spAttack' (EventName/EventParam) via the script-event builder param_1 (vtable +0x6c/+0x78).

Full combat-hit event builder: validates buff ids, maps buff types to names (poison/burn/Dynamite), emits AddBuff and spAttack events, then on a valid hit emits OnHit/DamageEvent with AttackDir, HitDamage (ceil formula), HitPoint, AttackerID, and AttackAttr bitmask; also enforces max-hit count (this[0x4a]++ vs this[0x49]).

Iterates the 10 buff-id slots of a hit source, validates each buff definition, checks its exclusiveGroup (record+0x424==-1), and instantiates buff effect instances on the target (param_4 vtable +0x44) passing source position/data (param_1+0x5c..0x88) and duration/flag from param_2+0x90; type code 0xb.

Serializes a hit/damage message to a field writer (vtable +0x18): attackerType, HitPoint(vec3), attackerNetID, Damage (ceil formula), buffFlag (32-bit, _ultoa_s), spAttackFlag (_ltoa_s). buffFlag OR'd over the 10 validated buffs; spAttackFlag from the 4 elemental entries.

Variant of the hit/damage serializer writing HitDir, attackerType, HitPos(vec3), attackerNetID, Damage, AttackAttr (FUN_10b28010), then a 64-bit buffFlag formatted as '%I64u' and spAttackFlag. buffFlag accumulated as two 32-bit halves over the 10 validated buffs.

Console/debug command handler (expects arg count 3): atoi(arg1)=entityId, atoi(arg2)=buffId; iterates the entity collection, finds entity whose field+0x14==entityId, looks up the buff definition, builds an add-buff request struct from record fields (0x10, 0x10c, 0x80) and dispatches it (vtable +0x40).

Entity hook (this has fields at 0x7b1/0x7b3/0x7b5/0x7c5): resolves an actor via its id (manager +0x7c GetById, +0xa8 type==0), calls base update (+0x1b4), then iterates the entity's buff-instance list (stride 5 ints at [0x7b5]+8), validates each buffId, and detaches/toggles its effect on the resolved actor (vtable +0x54). Confidence low.

Iterates an entity's buff-instance lists (at param+0x1ed4), validates each buffId, and for buffs whose definition has no effect yet (record+0x80==0) creates the effect via manager vtable +0x44, caching the handle in the instance (+0x10). Second loop repeats against a resolved sub-actor (id at +0x1ec4).

Copies a buff-container's scalar state into a local struct (choosing 0x100 vs 0x200 mode based on whether counters at [0x16]==[0x18]), then filters its two buff-id arrays (10 slots at 0x25.. and 21 slots at 0x2f..), keeping only buffs whose definition has record+0x44!=0, and finalizes/serializes the snapshot via FUN_10c24b30.
Walks the active-buff pair list (this+0xc..0x10, stride 2, key==1), validates each buffId, and returns true if predicate FUN_116a7820(arg) holds for any present buff.
Walks the active-buff pair list and returns true if any present buff's definition has buffCategory (record+0x420) equal to the argument.
Same as AnyBuffMatchesPredicateA but tests predicate FUN_116a78d0(arg) against each present, validated buff.

Parses a TlvRoleBuffList network message (FUN_101fced0/FUN_101fd2d0 = sub_101FD2D0) into up to N buff-instance records (stride 0x88), validates each buffId, runs its effect script (FUN_11475790 when record+0x80!=0), and applies/spawns the buff instance (FUN_11472c10 + FUN_11474ed0/FUN_11612230).

Sibling of ApplyRoleBuffListMessage for a different TLV (FUN_10301c10/FUN_10301dc0): parses buff records of stride 0x99 (with an embedded string field, PTR_FUN_11cd7298), validates each buffId, and applies each buff instance (FUN_11472cb0 + FUN_11474ed0/FUN_11612230).

Enumerates every CBuffInfo definition in the manager's contiguous array (base+0x14..0x18) and, for each valid record, runs three per-buff resource/precache steps (FUN_1154cce0, FUN_1154d0a0, FUN_1154cfc0). Returns 1.
Zeroes a 0x18c-byte work buffer, fills a buff-id list via FUN_116cfe60, then validates each collected buffId against the manager. Purpose beyond validation unclear; confidence low.

Decodes up to 10 buff ids from a packed field (FUN_100ec450 on this+0x14) and builds outputs: a presence bitmask (*param_2 |= 1<<record[0x420]) and a category->record pointer table (param_3[category]=record). Skips categories already filled.
Reads up to 10 buff ids from param_1+0x14 then appends more from param_2+0x14 (FUN_100ec450), and validates each combined buffId against the manager (existence check for two merged buff sources).
Iterates an 8-slot (0x20-byte) buff-id array at *(param_1+0x30) and validates each positive buffId against the manager.

Walks a list of cache objects (this[0xc..0xd], stride 0x50); for each, validates the buff ids in its embedded int list (+0x40..+0x44) and conditionally releases the entry (FUN_11679c30 then FUN_1169ee00 on obj+0x4c). Confidence low.
Enumerates all CBuffInfo definitions in the manager array and, for each non-null record, invokes FUN_116aa680 with the caller-supplied callback/context (param_1). A visit-all-buffs helper.

Reference/precache validation across info managers: validates a list of buff ids (count at this+0x38) against CBuffInfo, then (if this+0x80) validates a CPetSupportBuff reference, then validates 3 CItemBaseInfo references (pairs at this+0x68). Touches CPetSupportBuff and CItemBaseInfo managers.
Iterates a 0x18-byte-stride array (this+0x14..0x18); for entries with field+4!=0 validates the referenced CBuffInfo exists.
If a count (this+0x1c) is positive, validates that the CBuffInfo singleton/record is available (single existence check).

XML/config attribute reader using param_2 accessor vtable (+0x10 HasAttr, +0x20 GetInt, +0x28 GetString): reads 'GodLuckType' -> this+0x14, 'addbuff' -> this+0x18 (a buffId, then validated against the CBuffInfo manager), a name field (DAT_11d44360) -> string member, and 'sQaSI' -> this+0x10. Likely the reader for a lucky-draw/reward config that grants a buff rather than the core CBuffInfo record; flagged.
Validates a single referenced buff (this+0x28) and then every buffId in a list (this+0x2c..0x30) against the manager.

Returns false if an index accessor (vtable +0x18) is negative; otherwise checks the 5 buff-id slots at this+0x26 and returns true only if every non-zero buffId resolves to a valid CBuffInfo definition.
Corrupted/offcut disassembly fragment of the CBuffInfo singleton-init path (overlapping instructions, does-not-return); not a real distinct method. Confidence very low.

classes.notes: All 29 functions were auto-labeled 'CBuffInfo::GetManagers' only because they reference the CInfoManager<CBuffInfo> singleton-name string; their real behavior varies widely (event building, serialization, effect spawning, cross-reference validation) and several almost certainly belong to combat/entity/message-handler classes rather than to CBuffInfo itself. CBuffInfo is the static buff DEFINITION class (managed by CInfoManager, keyed by buffId); TlvBuffInfo is the separate runtime instance struct - do not conflate them, and the TlvBuffInfo field offsets do NOT map to the definition-record offsets recovered here (0x420 category, 0x424 group, 0x80 effect, 0x110 script). No reader for the core CBuffInfo definition record appears in this batch; the only reader (11a39890) loads GodLuckType/addbuff/sQaSI into a different (likely reward/luck) config class and is flagged as probable mis-bundling. The paged-array manager lookup (offsets 0x20/0x24/0x28/0x30) and the hit-descriptor layout (6 damage floats, 10 buff-id slots at 0x25, 4 spAttack elems at 0x1a/0x1c/0x1e/0x20) are consistent across the event/serialize functions. Field offsets on the definition record are inferred from usage, not from a DebugFormat printer, so confidence is medium.
